name: Arena Classic silicone swim cap
description: A tank. Thick, well-made silicone that resists tearing and survives seasons of daily chlorine.

name: Speedo Tech Paddle
description: The versatile everyday choice — a mid-size rectangular paddle with adjustable finger and wrist tubing. Big enough to build real strength, small enough not to instantly wreck your shoulders, and adjustable enough to grow with you.

name: Speedo Fastskin dome racing cap
description: A dome cap built for one job — reducing drag. The smooth silicone fits tighter and sleeker than a training cap to shave resistance at the surface, which is why you see it on the blocks at every big meet, often doubled over a first cap.

name: TYR Catalyst swim paddles
description: A power-builder's paddle — clear size options, a contoured shape, and adjustable straps that hold securely for heavy pull sets with a buoy. For experienced swimmers with solid technique who want to load the catch.
